title: Packaging Evidence Entry
description: D4 / EVP-A evidence entry (#606). idempotency_key = sha256(canon_arr(request_id stripped, entry_id)); keys, ids and pointers are stored bare hex (P1-7). Request binding is exact whole-string equality between envelope request_id and payload_digest (EV-REQUEST_BINDING_MISMATCH otherwise) and never uses the digest-input normalization.

request_id.description: Stored normalized to bare hex; a single sha256: prefix is accepted on input only.

payload_digest.description: Envelope-payload digest; request binding compares it to request_id by exact whole-string equality.
